## [1.4.0](https://github.com/bigyank/morphe-patches-samsung/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0) (2026-10-15)

### ✨ New Features

* add dex diff stage, version-watch automation, emulator smoke test ([add054b](https://github.com/bigyank/morphe-patches-samsung/commit/add054b77766a5bac34256f1736ad883435276d2))
* add hide-home-promotion-panel patch (issue [#6](https://github.com/bigyank/morphe-patches-samsung/issues/6)) ([5fa506b](https://github.com/bigyank/morphe-patches-samsung/commit/5fa506bd8c1522b1e0efbfd9efa986f619689519))

patches.name: Bypass Samsung Account provider checks
patches.description: Replaces com.osp.app.signin with com.notsamsung.dummy in dex and routes account lookups through Android AccountManager instead of Samsung Account's provider.

patches.name: Disable Knox integrity checks
patches.description: Bypass Knox, root, warranty bit, and SAK checks so Samsung Health runs on Knox-tripped devices (0x1) without root.

patches.name: Hide home promotion panel
patches.description: Removes the Discover+ advertising card from the home screen by replicating the app's own offline early-exit in the promotion load path. No-ops on builds without the promotion package.
